text: sambahulā antevāsikā kaṭṭhahārakā māṇavakāti . ahu pana bhoto kaccānassa tehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ koci deva kathāsallāpoti . ahu kho me brāhmaṇa tehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ [3] #1 ma. yu. apavadati . 2 ma. yu. ayaṃ pāṭho natthi . 3 ma. yu. kocideva kathāsallāpoti . ahosi kathāsallāpoti . yathā kathaṃ pana bhoto kaccānassa tehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ ahosi kathāsallāpoti . evaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa tehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ ahosi kathāsallāpoti . siṃluttamā pubbatarā ahesuṃ te brāhmaṇā ye purāṇaṃ saranti .
